title: Dictator's Bunker card-game
author: manandai_gamedev
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/5vyrzmk3ezwh1.png

  
I made a card game about dictator's running to hide in the grey dictator's bunker (totally free).   
  
The game has a tutorial and is only playable against AI. It came out fun, so I ordered the cards also as physical objects from 1vs1 gameplay :) Hope you like it, please post a comment!

[https://manandai.itch.io/dictators-bunker](https://manandai.itch.io/dictators-bunker)

**RULES**

Game is won by getting a dictators to one of the 4 seats in the bunker, every turn he spends in the bunker he creates points for you. A dictator may be removed from the bunker by serving him polonium tea.

The game ends when the old grey dictator enters the bunker.

Three resources in ascending value:

Internet trolls (green)  
Kompromat (yellow)  
Nuclear threats (red)

You can get tokens, transform them to other tokens and buy the dictator killing "tea party" card from the shop.



https://i.redd.it/jipzblg4ezwh1.jpeg

**INSPIRATION**

The gameplay takes inspiration from Century Spice Road (4 tokens, no bunker, no killing point cards etc.)

  
**DEVELOPMENT**

This was a test for me to see how fast I can create a fun playable game, this took 3 hours in total from inspiration to release on itch. Originally I had real world dictators/autocrats there but though it would be funnier and the satire stays if I change them to imagined ones. The game does not have audio and its horrid to play on mobile.
